markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the executive action is issued.
markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has taken any signed executive action renaming the Strait of Hormuz after himself after Issuance and before Sep 15, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The qualifying action must be of the specific type designated (executive order, presidential memorandum, proclamation, directive, determination, or finding), be signed by the President personally during the specified time period, and explicitly address the topic in the document's operative provisions, title, or official White House summary. Actions must have legal or policy effect - ceremonial proclamations without policy impact do not qualify unless specifically included. Actions that only incidentally mention the topic, statements without formal action, actions by cabinet members, legislative proposals without executive action, and signing statements do not qualify. The action must be publicly announced or documented by a Source Agency before expiration.

The action must adopt or direct adoption of a replacement for the preexisting name Strait of Hormuz for United States official use, with Trump as an integral element of the replacement name. Trump Strait and Strait of Trump qualify. A non-Trump replacement does not qualify. Merely using a Trump name as an alternate, honorary, or informal title does not qualify. A map, database, registry, contract, or other record change by an agency without the President's qualifying action does not qualify. An action covering only a portion of the waterway designated by the United States qualifies. Adoption by another country or an international body is not required.
markets.title: Will Trump rename the Strait of Hormuz after himself?

markets.rules_primary: If Zay Flowers finishes within the top 5 highest in total full-PPR fantasy points for all WRs in Week 1 of the 2026 Pro Football regular season, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market uses Sleeper's total full-PPR fantasy points for Week 1 of the 2026 Pro Football regular season, including overtime. It ranks all WRs, including eligible players without a listed market. Player-group membership is determined by Sleeper at expiration. If a player does not play in the week they will be considered to have scored 0 points.

Dead-heat rules apply in the event that two or more players are tied at the final qualifying position.

If a tie occurs at the cutoff position, each tied player's contract shall settle at 1/N, where N is the total number of players tied for the remaining qualifying position(s).

Example: In a market for the top 10 fantasy quarterbacks, if two quarterbacks are tied for 10th place, each tied player's contract will settle at $0.50.

Please read the scoring format below. All values are fantasy points under Sleeper’s default full-PPR scoring.

Passing, rushing, and receiving

Passing yards: +0.04 per yard (+1 per 25 yards).
Passing touchdown: +4.
Interception thrown: −1.
Passing two-point conversion: +2.
Rushing yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Rushing touchdown: +6.
Rushing two-point conversion: +2.
Reception: +1.
Receiving yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Receiving touchdown: +6.
Receiving two-point conversion: +2.

Kicking

Field goal made, 0–39 yards: +3.
Field goal made, 40–49 yards: +4.
Field goal made, 50–59 yards: +5.
Field goal made, 60+ yards: +6.
Extra point made: +1.
Field goal missed: −1.
Extra point missed: −1.

Defense and special teams (D/ST)

Defensive touchdown: +6.
Sack: +1.
Interception made: +2.
Defensive fumble recovery: +2.
Forced fumble: +1.
Safety: +2.
Blocked kick: +2.
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Special-teams forced fumble: +1.
Special-teams fumble recovery: +1.

D/ST points allowed per game

0 points allowed: +10.
1–6 points allowed: +7.
7–13 points allowed: +4.
14–20 points allowed: +1.
21–27 points allowed: 0.
28–34 points allowed: −1.
35+ points allowed: −4.

Individual-player special teams and fumbles
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Fumble: 0.
Fumble lost: −2.
Fumble-recovery touchdown: +6.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the National Football League or Sleeper. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

markets.rules_primary: If DK Metcalf finishes within the top 5 highest in total full-PPR fantasy points for all WRs in Week 1 of the 2026 Pro Football regular season, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market uses Sleeper's total full-PPR fantasy points for Week 1 of the 2026 Pro Football regular season, including overtime. It ranks all WRs, including eligible players without a listed market. Player-group membership is determined by Sleeper at expiration. If a player does not play in the week they will be considered to have scored 0 points.

Dead-heat rules apply in the event that two or more players are tied at the final qualifying position.

If a tie occurs at the cutoff position, each tied player's contract shall settle at 1/N, where N is the total number of players tied for the remaining qualifying position(s).

Example: In a market for the top 10 fantasy quarterbacks, if two quarterbacks are tied for 10th place, each tied player's contract will settle at $0.50.

Please read the scoring format below. All values are fantasy points under Sleeper’s default full-PPR scoring.

Passing, rushing, and receiving

Passing yards: +0.04 per yard (+1 per 25 yards).
Passing touchdown: +4.
Interception thrown: −1.
Passing two-point conversion: +2.
Rushing yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Rushing touchdown: +6.
Rushing two-point conversion: +2.
Reception: +1.
Receiving yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Receiving touchdown: +6.
Receiving two-point conversion: +2.

Kicking

Field goal made, 0–39 yards: +3.
Field goal made, 40–49 yards: +4.
Field goal made, 50–59 yards: +5.
Field goal made, 60+ yards: +6.
Extra point made: +1.
Field goal missed: −1.
Extra point missed: −1.

Defense and special teams (D/ST)

Defensive touchdown: +6.
Sack: +1.
Interception made: +2.
Defensive fumble recovery: +2.
Forced fumble: +1.
Safety: +2.
Blocked kick: +2.
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Special-teams forced fumble: +1.
Special-teams fumble recovery: +1.

D/ST points allowed per game

0 points allowed: +10.
1–6 points allowed: +7.
7–13 points allowed: +4.
14–20 points allowed: +1.
21–27 points allowed: 0.
28–34 points allowed: −1.
35+ points allowed: −4.

Individual-player special teams and fumbles
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Fumble: 0.
Fumble lost: −2.
Fumble-recovery touchdown: +6.

markets.rules_primary: If Joe Burrow finishes within the top 5 highest in total full-PPR fantasy points for all QBs in Week 1 of the 2026 Pro Football regular season, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market uses Sleeper's total full-PPR fantasy points for Week 1 of the 2026 Pro Football regular season, including overtime. It ranks all QBs, including eligible players without a listed market. Player-group membership is determined by Sleeper at expiration. If a player does not play in the week they will be considered to have scored 0 points.

Dead-heat rules apply in the event that two or more players are tied at the final qualifying position.

If a tie occurs at the cutoff position, each tied player's contract shall settle at 1/N, where N is the total number of players tied for the remaining qualifying position(s).

Example: In a market for the top 10 fantasy quarterbacks, if two quarterbacks are tied for 10th place, each tied player's contract will settle at $0.50.

Please read the scoring format below. All values are fantasy points under Sleeper’s default full-PPR scoring.

Passing, rushing, and receiving

Passing yards: +0.04 per yard (+1 per 25 yards).
Passing touchdown: +4.
Interception thrown: −1.
Passing two-point conversion: +2.
Rushing yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Rushing touchdown: +6.
Rushing two-point conversion: +2.
Reception: +1.
Receiving yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Receiving touchdown: +6.
Receiving two-point conversion: +2.

Kicking

Field goal made, 0–39 yards: +3.
Field goal made, 40–49 yards: +4.
Field goal made, 50–59 yards: +5.
Field goal made, 60+ yards: +6.
Extra point made: +1.
Field goal missed: −1.
Extra point missed: −1.

Defense and special teams (D/ST)

Defensive touchdown: +6.
Sack: +1.
Interception made: +2.
Defensive fumble recovery: +2.
Forced fumble: +1.
Safety: +2.
Blocked kick: +2.
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Special-teams forced fumble: +1.
Special-teams fumble recovery: +1.

D/ST points allowed per game

0 points allowed: +10.
1–6 points allowed: +7.
7–13 points allowed: +4.
14–20 points allowed: +1.
21–27 points allowed: 0.
28–34 points allowed: −1.
35+ points allowed: −4.

Individual-player special teams and fumbles
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Fumble: 0.
Fumble lost: −2.
Fumble-recovery touchdown: +6.

markets.rules_secondary:
This market uses Sleeper's total full-PPR fantasy points for Week 1 of the 2026 Pro Football regular season, including overtime. It ranks all WRs, including eligible players without a listed market. Player-group membership is determined by Sleeper at expiration. If a player does not play in the week they will be considered to have scored 0 points.

If multiple players tie for the most fantasy points, the markets will resolve to 1/N, where N is the number of players tied for the highest value. No holders will receive $1 minus the Yes payout.

Please read the scoring format below. All values are fantasy points under Sleeper’s default full-PPR scoring.

Passing, rushing, and receiving

Passing yards: +0.04 per yard (+1 per 25 yards).
Passing touchdown: +4.
Interception thrown: −1.
Passing two-point conversion: +2.
Rushing yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Rushing touchdown: +6.
Rushing two-point conversion: +2.
Reception: +1.
Receiving yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Receiving touchdown: +6.
Receiving two-point conversion: +2.

Kicking

Field goal made, 0–39 yards: +3.
Field goal made, 40–49 yards: +4.
Field goal made, 50–59 yards: +5.
Field goal made, 60+ yards: +6.
Extra point made: +1.
Field goal missed: −1.
Extra point missed: −1.

Defense and special teams (D/ST)

Defensive touchdown: +6.
Sack: +1.
Interception made: +2.
Defensive fumble recovery: +2.
Forced fumble: +1.
Safety: +2.
Blocked kick: +2.
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Special-teams forced fumble: +1.
Special-teams fumble recovery: +1.

D/ST points allowed per game

0 points allowed: +10.
1–6 points allowed: +7.
7–13 points allowed: +4.
14–20 points allowed: +1.
21–27 points allowed: 0.
28–34 points allowed: −1.
35+ points allowed: −4.

Individual-player special teams and fumbles
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Fumble: 0.
Fumble lost: −2.
Fumble-recovery touchdown: +6.

Kicking

Field goal made, 50–59 yards: +5.
Field goal made, 60+ yards: +6.
Extra point made: +1.
Field goal missed: −1.
Extra point missed: −1.

Defensive touchdown: +6.
Sack: +1.
Interception made: +2.
Defensive fumble recovery: +2.
Forced fumble: +1.
Safety: +2.
Blocked kick: +2.
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Special-teams forced fumble: +1.

0 points allowed: +10.

14–20 points allowed: +1.
21–27 points allowed: 0.

Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Fumble: 0.

markets.rules_secondary:
This market uses Sleeper's total full-PPR fantasy points for Week 1 of the 2026 Pro Football regular season, including overtime. It ranks all players, including eligible players without a listed market. Player-group membership is determined by Sleeper at expiration. If a player does not play in the week they will be considered to have scored 0 points.

If multiple players tie for the most fantasy points, the markets will resolve to 1/N, where N is the number of players tied for the highest value. No holders will receive $1 minus the Yes payout.

Please read the scoring format below. All values are fantasy points under Sleeper’s default full-PPR scoring.

Passing, rushing, and receiving

Passing yards: +0.04 per yard (+1 per 25 yards).
Passing touchdown: +4.
Interception thrown: −1.
Passing two-point conversion: +2.
Rushing yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Rushing touchdown: +6.
Rushing two-point conversion: +2.
Reception: +1.
Receiving yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Receiving touchdown: +6.
Receiving two-point conversion: +2.

Kicking

Field goal made, 0–39 yards: +3.
Field goal made, 40–49 yards: +4.
Field goal made, 50–59 yards: +5.
Field goal made, 60+ yards: +6.
Extra point made: +1.
Field goal missed: −1.
Extra point missed: −1.

Defense and special teams (D/ST)

Defensive touchdown: +6.
Sack: +1.
Interception made: +2.
Defensive fumble recovery: +2.
Forced fumble: +1.
Safety: +2.
Blocked kick: +2.
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Special-teams forced fumble: +1.
Special-teams fumble recovery: +1.

D/ST points allowed per game

0 points allowed: +10.
1–6 points allowed: +7.
7–13 points allowed: +4.
14–20 points allowed: +1.
21–27 points allowed: 0.
28–34 points allowed: −1.
35+ points allowed: −4.

Individual-player special teams and fumbles
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Fumble: 0.
Fumble lost: −2.
Fumble-recovery touchdown: +6.

This market uses Sleeper's total full-PPR fantasy points for Week 1 of the 2026 Pro Football regular season, including overtime. It ranks all players, including eligible players without a listed market. Player-group membership is determined by Sleeper at expiration. If a player does not play in the week they will be considered to have scored 0 points.

If multiple players tie for the most fantasy points, the markets will resolve to 1/N, where N is the number of players tied for the highest value. No holders will receive $1 minus the Yes payout.

Please read the scoring format below. All values are fantasy points under Sleeper’s default full-PPR scoring.

Passing, rushing, and receiving

Passing yards: +0.04 per yard (+1 per 25 yards).
Passing touchdown: +4.
Interception thrown: −1.
Passing two-point conversion: +2.
Rushing yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Rushing touchdown: +6.
Rushing two-point conversion: +2.
Reception: +1.
Receiving yards: +0.1 per yard (+1 per 10 yards).
Receiving touchdown: +6.
Receiving two-point conversion: +2.

Kicking

Field goal made, 0–39 yards: +3.
Field goal made, 40–49 yards: +4.
Field goal made, 50–59 yards: +5.
Field goal made, 60+ yards: +6.
Extra point made: +1.
Field goal missed: −1.
Extra point missed: −1.

Defense and special teams (D/ST)

Defensive touchdown: +6.
Sack: +1.
Interception made: +2.
Defensive fumble recovery: +2.
Forced fumble: +1.
Safety: +2.
Blocked kick: +2.
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Special-teams forced fumble: +1.
Special-teams fumble recovery: +1.

D/ST points allowed per game

0 points allowed: +10.
1–6 points allowed: +7.
7–13 points allowed: +4.
14–20 points allowed: +1.
21–27 points allowed: 0.
28–34 points allowed: −1.
35+ points allowed: −4.

Individual-player special teams and fumbles
Special-teams touchdown: +6.
Fumble: 0.
Fumble lost: −2.
Fumble-recovery touchdown: +6.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the executive action is issued.
markets.rules_primary: If Donald Trump has taken any signed executive action renaming the Strait of Hormuz to any different name after Issuance and before Sep 15, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The qualifying action must be of the specific type designated (executive order, presidential memorandum, proclamation, directive, determination, or finding), be signed by the President personally during the specified time period, and explicitly address the topic in the document's operative provisions, title, or official White House summary. Actions must have legal or policy effect - ceremonial proclamations without policy impact do not qualify unless specifically included. Actions that only incidentally mention the topic, statements without formal action, actions by cabinet members, legislative proposals without executive action, and signing statements do not qualify. The action must be publicly announced or documented by a Source Agency before expiration.

The action must adopt or direct adoption of a replacement for the preexisting name Strait of Hormuz for United States official use. Merely using an alternate, honorary, or informal name does not qualify. A map, database, registry, contract, or other record change by an agency without the President's qualifying action does not qualify. An action covering only a portion of the waterway designated by the United States qualifies. Adoption by another country or an international body is not required.
markets.title: Will Trump rename the Strait of Hormuz?

markets.rules_primary: If Ripple has the highest return out of BTC (Bitcoin), ETH (Ethereum), SOL (Solana), XRP (Ripple), and HYPE (Hyperliquid) in from Sep 14 - 10:00PM EDT to 10:15PM EDT, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The return for each cryptocurrency in the specified set is calculated independently over the given time period using the formula: Return = (Ending Price − Starting Price) / Starting Price × 100. The Starting Price and Ending Price are defined as the time-weighted average of the Spot Rate values published by CFBenchmarks during the 60-second intervals immediately preceding the start and end of the time period, respectively. Final returns are calculated on an identical basis for every cryptocurrency in the set and rounded to three decimal places (as a percentage).

If two or more cryptocurrencies report an identical return (rounded to three decimal places) such that they are tied for the highest
position, each tied cryptocurrency's Contract will resolve to "Yes" with a value equal to $1 divided by the number of cryptocurrencies tied for the highest position,
rounded down to the nearest cent, and each remaining (non-tied) cryptocurrency's
Contract will resolve to "No."
